name: @antiphony/docs
description: Antiphony documentation site — Astro Starlight. Deploys to Cloudflare Workers (static assets) at docs.antiphony.dev.
//scripts.astro: A PASSTHROUGH (`npm run astro -w @antiphony/docs -- add <integration>`), and the body is the word `astro` — not a version. fee1bce, a Dependabot production-minor group bump, rewrote it to `^7.3.1` while bumping the real `astro` dependency below: the group matched on the KEY NAME and clobbered the script entry alongside it, so `npm run astro` ran `sh -c ^7.3.1` for six days. Nothing caught it because no workflow invokes this script. If a future group bump touches this line again, that is the same bug, not a new one.
